_how: Copy this file to campaigns.json and fill it in. Use forward slashes in paths, even on Windows (C:/Users/Me/Vault). Folders inside a vault are written relative to the vault. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

My Campaign._vault: The Obsidian vault folder (the one that holds the .obsidian folder).
My Campaign._browse: Folders whose notes appear in the Adventure picker, as [label, folder]. Each note's 'Show the players' boxes become clickable pictures.
My Campaign._place_images: Folder with place pictures named '<Place> 1.png', '<Place> 2.png' and so on.
My Campaign._place_notes: Folder with one note per place, named exactly like its pictures, with 'region' and 'first_visited' properties. Leave out if you have none.
My Campaign._npc_notes: Folder with one note per NPC: portrait embedded in the note, plus 'location' and 'met' properties.
My Campaign._portrait_images: Folder with the NPC portraits, used to make the see-through cut-outs.
My Campaign._item_notes: Optional: folder with one note per item (sword, amulet, letter): picture embedded in the note, plus 'found', and 'card_name' or 'location' if you like. Leave out if you have none.
My Campaign._item_images: Optional: folder with the item pictures named '<Item> 1.png', used for the see-through cut-outs. A picture here without a note still shows up as an item.
My Campaign._skip_folders: Folders to ignore when searching for pictures (rulebooks, templates).
